name: tfl_station_footfall
title: TfL station entries and exits per day (station footfall)
description: Entry and exit gate taps for every station in TfL's daily footfall series — around 440 Underground, Elizabeth line, DLR, London Overground and some National Rail gate lines — one row per station per day from 1 January 2019. TfL publishes the series as overlapping yearly and rolling two-year CSVs that it rewrites in place about weekly, with small late corrections and no public history; this table resolves the overlaps (the file covering the latest period wins) into a single deduplicated series, and the raw zip preserves each week's files exactly as published. Powered by TfL Open Data.

sources.title: Transport for London — Network Demand open data (crowding.data.tfl.gov.uk, folder 'Network Demand', StationFootfall_*.csv)

update_cadence: TfL rewrites the current file roughly weekly, with data to about a week before upload, and is refreshed here weekly; older periods are occasionally re-uploaded with corrections.
caveats: These are gate taps, not journeys or people: one trip through two stations in the series counts as an entry at one and an exit at the other, and changing lines inside a station produces no tap.
Travel through open gates (disruption, gates left open) is not counted, and paper tickets may be under-counted.
A station-day with no row is missing, not zero — e.g. stations closed for works or strikes, or not yet open. Do not fill gaps with 0 without checking.

Station names are TfL's labels for this series and do not always match TfL's API (StopPoint) names. They change over time: 'Woolwich EL', 'Canary Wharf EL' and 'Custom House EL' became '... Elizabeth Line' from 2025-05-28, and an 'Unknown' station appears from February 2020 to December 2022. Names are published verbatim apart from trimming whitespace ('Cannon Street ' in the 2019-22 files).

Elizabeth line: Paddington has a separate 'Paddington EL' row from 2021; Bond Street and Tottenham Court Road have no separate Elizabeth line row, so their figures probably include Elizabeth line entrances — compare across May 2022 (central section opening) with care.
Covid-19: 2020 and 2021 (and early 2022) reflect lockdowns and recovery; do not use them as a baseline.

Overlaps between TfL's files are resolved by taking each station-day from the file covering the latest period (e.g. StationFootfall_2025_2026 beats StationFootfall_2024_2025); source_file records which file each row came from. The newest period is subject to small revisions in later weekly uploads.
TfL keeps no history of superseded figures — earlier versions are preserved only by this dataset's commit history and monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags.

Attribution required by the licence: "Powered by TfL Open Data". The licence also asks re-users to acknowledge Ordnance Survey derived data where present ("Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights 2016" and Geomni UK Map data © and database rights [2019]).

resources.name: station_footfall_parquet
resources.description: One row per station per day, overlaps between TfL's files resolved (latest period wins), sorted by travel_date then station. Derived from the raw zip, which is authoritative.

fields.name: travel_date
fields.description: Date of travel, ISO yyyy-mm-dd (TfL publishes yyyymmdd).

fields.name: day_of_week
fields.description: Day name, Monday to Sunday; always consistent with travel_date.

fields.name: station
fields.description: TfL's station label for this series, verbatim apart from trimmed whitespace (see caveats on renames).

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: The TfL file this row was taken from, exactly as named in the bucket (some names contain a stray space before '.csv').

resources.name: raw_zip
resources.description: Every StationFootfall_*.csv in TfL's Network Demand folder at fetch time, unmodified and under TfL's own filenames, bundled into one deterministic zip — the archival record, since TfL overwrites these files in place.
